method: Exhaustive geometric centre-pair scan within each radius, followed by normalized/translated/reordered/fuzzy primary and alias name comparison and manual candidate assessment. Distance alone is not treated as identity outside the existing 1 km grouping.
scope: Practical cleanup; 95% is the user acceptance target, not measured duplicate recall. Different-name duplicates can escape name screening. Uncertain same-name sectors remain separate.
stoppingReason: Widened 2 → 5 → 10 → 15 → 25 km. Last confirmed duplicate is the misplaced Pelzerhaken point at 15.537 km; the remaining 16–25 km candidates are generic names or different coastal locations. No new name candidates appear after rebuilding. Further radius expansion is low yield for this cleanup.
